title: forge:propose post-validation policy
description: V1..V6 checks executed AFTER opsx:propose generates artifacts and BEFORE the human approval gate. Any failing check blocks the gate.

checks.name: scope-limits
checks.description: Output of opsx:propose does not exceed scope_limits.* (specs, tasks, waves, files_modified, deps_depth).
checks.on_fail: Report which limit was breached. Abort and instruct to split into multiple changes.

checks.name: files-exist
checks.description: Every spec referenced path resolves on the filesystem (fs.access).
checks.on_fail: List invalid paths with the spec they came from. Abort.

checks.name: contracts-stable
checks.description: No spec touches a file or interface listed in change-brief.contracts.stable_list (W4).
checks.on_fail: List the violating spec → contract pair. Abort.

checks.name: required-tools-present
checks.description: Plan declares required_tools (W7 contract) for every dispatchable agent in the wave.

checks.name: human-summary-present
checks.description: Plan includes a human_summary block (W13 contract) in es-MX prefixed by **En simple:**.
checks.on_fail: Report missing human_summary. Abort — DO NOT proceed to approval gate without dual-language summary.

checks.name: specs-per-wave
checks.on_fail: Report wave numbers with excess specs. Abort and split into more waves.
